description: Comprehensive Evaluation of Seismic Protection Systems for Safety-Related Control Cabinets is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Gilberto Mosqueda, University of California San Diego (ucsd.edu). This project contains the data supporting the study "Comprehensive Evaluation of Seismic Protection Systems for Safety-Related Control Cabinets." The dataset includes the information used to generate the results, figures, tables, and analyses presented in the associated publication. Safety-related electrical cabinets house critical control systems required for emergency operation and safe shutdown in power plants. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 62 top-level files (5S, XLSX). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-ka2g-0749. Keywords: Non-structural elements; , Electrical cabinets, OpenSees modeling, Tuned mass damper, Seismic isolation, Wire rope isolator. Published 2026-05-31. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
